events.title: DeepSeek opens Search and Fetch APIs for agent retrieval
events.title_zh: DeepSeek 开放面向 agent 检索的 Search 与 Fetch API
events.summary_zh: DeepSeek 开放 Search 与 Fetch 两个原始 API，分别返回结构化搜索结果与网页 Markdown。两者按成功且非空的请求计费，均为每千次 0.75 美元，并各有账户级 5 QPS 限制。通过 DeepSeek Harness、Claude Code 与 Codex 调用的服务端工具暂时免费到北京时间 11 月 1 日。
events.summary_en: DeepSeek opened raw Search and Fetch APIs that return structured search results and webpage Markdown. Each costs $0.75 per 1,000 successful non-empty requests and has a separate account-level 5 QPS limit. Server-side tool calls through DeepSeek Harness, Claude Code and Codex are temporarily free until November 1 Beijing time.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对构建 RAG 或 agent 的团队来说，这把检索成本从模型 token 中拆开，并提供低价可测的抓取路径；但权威度字段只是供应商元数据，相关性、归因与提示注入防护仍需自己验证。
events.why_it_matters_en: For RAG and agent teams, this separates retrieval cost from model tokens and offers a low-cost fetch path. The authority field is vendor metadata, so relevance, attribution and prompt-injection defenses still need local validation.

events.title: H2O.ai updates its 4B decision model with two-way reading
events.title_zh: H2O.ai 为 4B 决策模型加入双向读取
events.summary_zh: H2O.ai 发布 H2O-Lightning-4B v1.3.1。这个 4B 模型用一次前向计算和一个输出 token 返回 choice、yes/no 或 score 的概率；新版本默认加入双向读取，可处理文本与图片，并在未修改的 vLLM 前加轻量 shim。权重与在线 demo 已公开。
events.summary_en: H2O.ai released H2O-Lightning-4B v1.3.1. The 4B model returns choice, yes/no or score probabilities in one forward pass and one output token. The update defaults to two-way reading, handles text and images, and uses a small shim in front of unmodified vLLM. Weights and a live demo are public.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对需要路由、审核或策略判定的团队来说，一次前向计算能把延迟与成本从生成式模型中拆出来。榜单第一对应旧版 v1.1，v1.3.1 的公开集改进不显著且视觉分数略有回退，不能把榜单名次直接套到新权重。
events.why_it_matters_en: For routing, review and policy decisions, one forward pass can separate latency and cost from generative models. The top leaderboard entry uses older v1.1 weights; v1.3.1 shows no significant public-set gain and a small vision regression, so the rank does not transfer directly to the new checkpoint.

technical_details.model: 4B model based on Qwen3.5-4B; text and image decisions
technical_details.interface: choice, yes/no and score probability outputs; one forward pass and one output token
technical_details.availability: Apache-2.0 weights, shim and Hugging Face demo
technical_details.evidence: v1.1 ranks first on the external JevBench open board; v1.3.1 public-set differences are not statistically significant and private board was not rerun
